items.title: ai-job-search
items.description: The job search that runs on your machine. AI job application framework built on Claude Code: evaluate postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, prep interviews. Fork it and own it.
items.description_zh: 在您的计算机上运行的职位搜索。基于 Claude Code 构建的人工智能职位申请框架：评估职位、定制简历、撰写求职信、准备面试。分叉并拥有它。

items.title: security-audit-skill
items.description: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings
items.description_zh: 用于多阶段安全审计的编码代理技能，具有独立验证、机器可读的结果

items.title: orca
items.description: Orca is the place for working with a fleet of agents (e.g. Grok Bot, Claude Code). Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.
items.description_zh: Orca 是与代理团队（例如 Grok Bot、Claude Code）合作的地方。使用您自己的订阅运行任何编码代理。可在桌面、移动和远程运行时使用。

items.title: ponytail
items.description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.
items.description_zh: 让你的人工智能代理像房间里最懒的高级开发人员一样思考。最好的代码是你从未编写过的代码。

items.title: ComfyUI
items.description: The most powerful and modular diffusion model GUI, api and backend with a graph/nodes interface. The fastest local inference engine in the world.
items.description_zh: 最强大的模块化扩散模型 GUI、API 和带有图形/节点接口的后端。世界上最快的本地推理引擎。

items.title: ruflo
items.description: 🌊 The original agent harness. Deploy intelligent multi-player swarms, coordinate autonomous workflows, and build conversational AI systems. Features adaptive memory, self-learning intelligence, federation, vector RAG integration, and native Claude Code / Codex / Hermes and many more Integrated
items.description_zh: 🌊 原始特工安全带。部署智能多人群体、协调自主工作流程并构建对话式人工智能系统。具有自适应记忆、自学习智能、联邦、矢量 RAG 集成以及原生 Claude Code / Codex / Hermes 等集成功能

items.title: graphify
items.description: Turn any codebase, with its docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. A /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI: local deterministic AST parsing, every edge explained, no vector store.
items.description_zh: 将任何代码库及其文档、SQL 架构、配置和 PDF 转换为可查询的知识图。适用于 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 和 Gemini CLI 的 /graphify 技能：本地确定性 AST 解析，每条边均已解释，无向量存储。

items.title: agency-agents
items.description: A complete AI agency at your fingertips - From frontend wizards to Reddit community ninjas, from whimsy injectors to reality checkers. Each agent is a specialized expert with personality, processes, and proven deliverables.
items.description_zh: 触手可及的完整人工智能机构 - 从前端向导到 Reddit 社区忍者，从奇思妙想的注入者到现实检查者。每个代理都是一位具有个性、流程和经过验证的可交付成果的专业专家。

items.title: headroom
items.description: Compress tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM. 20% fewer tokens for coding agents, 60-95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. Library, proxy, MCP server.
items.description_zh: 在工具输出、日志、文件和 RAG 块到达 LLM 之前对其进行压缩。编码代理的标记减少了 20%，JSON 的标记减少了 60-95%，答案相同。库、代理、MCP 服务器。

items.title: knowledge-work-plugins
items.description: Open source repository of plugins primarily intended for knowledge workers to use in Claude Cowork
items.description_zh: 主要供知识工作者在 Claude Cowork 中使用的开源插件存储库

items.title: Kronos
items.description: Kronos: A Foundation Model for the Language of Financial Markets
items.description_zh: Kronos：金融市场语言的基础模型

items.title: vllm
items.description: A high-throughput and memory-efficient inference and serving engine for LLMs
items.description_zh: 适用于LLM的高吞吐量和内存高效推理和服务引擎
